versos.hebraico: אַל־תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאַנְשֵׁ֣י רָעָ֑ה וְאַל־תתאו לִהְי֥וֹת אִתָּֽם׃

controles.web: Don’t be envious of evil men; neither desire to be with them:
controles.kjv: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
controles.livre: Não tenhas inveja dos homens malignos, nem desejes estar com eles;

versos.hebraico: כִּי־שֹׁ֭ד יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לִבָּ֑ם וְ֝עָמָ֗ל שִׂפְתֵיהֶ֥ם תְּדַבֵּֽרְנָה׃

controles.web: for their hearts plot violence, and their lips talk about mischief.
controles.kjv: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
controles.livre: Porque o coração deles imagina destruição, e os lábios deles falam de opressão.

versos.hebraico: בְּ֭חָכְמָה יִבָּ֣נֶה בָּ֑יִת וּ֝בִתְבוּנָ֗ה יִתְכּוֹנָֽן׃

controles.web: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;
controles.kjv: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
controles.livre: Pela sabedoria a casa é edificada, e pelo entendimento ela fica firme;

versos.hebraico: וּ֭בְדַעַת חֲדָרִ֣ים יִמָּלְא֑וּ כָּל־ה֖וֹן יָקָ֣ר וְנָעִֽים׃

controles.web: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
controles.kjv: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
controles.livre: E pelo conhecimento os cômodos se encherão de riquezas preciosas e agradáveis.

versos.hebraico: גֶּֽבֶר־חָכָ֥ם בַּע֑וֹז וְאִֽישׁ־דַּ֝֗עַת מְאַמֶּץ־כֹּֽחַ׃

controles.web: A wise man has great power; and a knowledgeable man increases strength;
controles.kjv: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
controles.livre: O homem sábio é poderoso; e o homem que tem conhecimento aumenta sua força;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י בְ֭תַחְבֻּלוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ֣ מִלְחָמָ֑ה וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ׃

controles.web: for by wise guidance you wage your war; and victory is in many advisors.
controles.kjv: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
controles.livre: Porque com conselhos prudentes farás tua guerra; e a vitória é alcançada pela abundância de conselheiros.

versos.hebraico: רָאמ֣וֹת לֶֽאֱוִ֣יל חָכְמ֑וֹת בַּ֝שַּׁ֗עַר לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח־פִּֽיהוּ׃

controles.web: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.
controles.kjv: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.
controles.livre: A sabedoria é alta demais para o tolo; na porta do julgamento ele não abre sua boca.

versos.hebraico: מְחַשֵּׁ֥ב לְהָרֵ֑עַ ל֝֗וֹ בַּֽעַל־מְזִמּ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽאוּ׃

controles.web: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.
controles.kjv: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
controles.livre: Quem planeja fazer o mal será chamado de vilão.

versos.hebraico: זִמַּ֣ת אִוֶּ֣לֶת חַטָּ֑את וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת לְאָדָ֣ם לֵֽץ׃

controles.web: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.
controles.kjv: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
controles.livre: O pensamento do tolo é pecado; e o zombador é abominável aos homens.

versos.hebraico: הִ֭תְרַפִּיתָ בְּי֥וֹם צָרָ֗ה צַ֣ר כֹּחֶֽכָה׃

controles.web: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.
controles.kjv: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.
controles.livre: Se te mostrares fraco no dia da angústia, como é pouca tua força!

versos.hebraico: הַ֭צֵּל לְקֻחִ֣ים לַמָּ֑וֶת וּמָטִ֥ים לַ֝הֶ֗רֶג אִם־תַּחְשֽׂוֹךְ׃

controles.web: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
controles.kjv: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
controles.livre: Livra os que estão tomados para a morte, os que estão sendo levados para serem mortos;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־תֹאמַ֗ר הֵן֮ לֹא־יָדַ֪עְנ֫וּ זֶ֥ה הֲֽלֹא־תֹ֘כֵ֤ן לִבּ֨וֹת׀ הֽוּא־יָבִ֗ין וְנֹצֵ֣ר נַ֭פְשְׁךָ ה֣וּא יֵדָ֑ע וְהֵשִׁ֖יב לְאָדָ֣ם כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ׃

controles.web: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this”; doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not render to every man according to his work?
controles.kjv: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
controles.livre: Pois se tu disseres: Eis que não sabíamos,Por acaso aquele que pesa os corações não saberá? Aquele que guarda tua alma não conhecerá? Ele retribuirá ao homem conforme sua obra.

versos.hebraico: אֱכָל־בְּנִ֣י דְבַ֣שׁ כִּי־ט֑וֹב וְנֹ֥פֶת מָ֝ת֗וֹק עַל־חִכֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: My son, eat honey, for it is good; the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste:
controles.kjv: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:
controles.livre: Come mel, meu filho, porque é bom; e o favo de mel é doce ao teu paladar.

versos.hebraico: כֵּ֤ן׀ דְּעֶ֥ה חָכְמָ֗ה לְנַ֫פְשֶׁ֥ךָ אִם־מָ֭צָאתָ וְיֵ֣שׁ אַחֲרִ֑ית וְ֝תִקְוָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִכָּרֵֽת׃פ

controles.web: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul; if you have found it, then there will be a reward, your hope will not be cut off.
controles.kjv: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
controles.livre: Assim será o conhecimento da sabedoria para tua alma; se a encontrares haverá recompensa para ti ; e tua esperança não será cortada.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תֶּאֱרֹ֣ב רָ֭שָׁע לִנְוֵ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק אַֽל־תְּשַׁדֵּ֥ד רִבְצוֹ׃

controles.web: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place:
controles.kjv: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
controles.livre: Tu, perverso, não espies a habitação do justo, nem assoles seu quarto;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨בַע׀ יִפּ֣וֹל צַדִּ֣יק וָקָ֑ם וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ בְרָעָֽה׃

controles.web: for a righteous man falls seven times, and rises up again; but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
controles.kjv: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
controles.livre: Porque o justo cai sete vezes, e se levanta; mas os perversos tropeçam no mal.

versos.hebraico: בִּנְפֹ֣ל אויביך אַל־תִּשְׂמָ֑ח וּ֝בִכָּשְׁל֗וֹ אַל־יָגֵ֥ל לִבֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown;
controles.kjv: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:
controles.livre: Quando teu inimigo cair, não te alegres; nem teu coração fique contente quando ele tropeçar,

versos.hebraico: פֶּן־יִרְאֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה וְרַ֣ע בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְהֵשִׁ֖יב מֵעָלָ֣יו אַפּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: lest Yahweh see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
controles.kjv: Lest the Lord see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
controles.livre: Para que não aconteça de o SENHOR veja, e o desagrade, e desvie dele sua ira.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל־תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בָּרְשָׁעִֽים׃

controles.web: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers; neither be envious of the wicked:
controles.kjv: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;
controles.livre: Não te irrites com os malfeitores, nem tenhas inveja dos perversos;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י׀ לֹֽא־תִהְיֶ֣ה אַחֲרִ֣ית לָרָ֑ע נֵ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָֽךְ׃

controles.web: for there will be no reward to the evil man; and the lamp of the wicked shall be snuffed out.
controles.kjv: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
controles.livre: Porque o maligno não terá um bom futuro; a lâmpada dos perversos se apagará.

versos.hebraico: יְרָֽא־אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה בְּנִ֣י וָמֶ֑לֶךְ עִם־שׁ֝וֹנִ֗ים אַל־תִּתְעָרָֽב׃

controles.web: My son, fear Yahweh and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious:
controles.kjv: My son, fear thou the Lord and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
controles.livre: Meu filho, teme ao SENHRO e ao rei; e não te envolvas com os rebeldes;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־פִ֭תְאֹם יָק֣וּם אֵידָ֑ם וּפִ֥יד שְׁ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם מִ֣י יוֹדֵֽעַ׃ס

controles.web: for their calamity will rise suddenly; the destruction from them both—who knows?
controles.kjv: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
controles.livre: Porque a destruição deles se levantará de repente; e quem sabe que ruína eles terão?

versos.hebraico: גַּם־אֵ֥לֶּה לַֽחֲכָמִ֑ים הַֽכֵּר־פָּנִ֖ים בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט בַּל־טֽוֹב׃

controles.web: These also are sayings of the wise.  To show partiality in judgment is not good.
controles.kjv: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
controles.livre: Estes provérbios também são para os sábios: fazer acepção de pessoas num julgamento não é bom.

versos.hebraico: אֹ֤מֵ֨ר׀ לְרָשָׁע֮ צַדִּ֪יק אָ֥תָּה יִקְּבֻ֥הוּ עַמִּ֑ים יִזְעָמ֥וּהוּ לְאֻמִּֽים׃

controles.web: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous”; peoples shall curse him, and nations shall abhor him—
controles.kjv: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
controles.livre: Aquele que disser ao ímpio: Tu és justo,Os povos o amaldiçoarão, as nações o detestarão.

versos.hebraico: וְלַמּוֹכִיחִ֥ים יִנְעָ֑ם וַֽ֝עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם תָּב֥וֹא בִרְכַּת־טֽוֹב׃

controles.web: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.
controles.kjv: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
controles.livre: Mas para aqueles que o repreenderem, haverá coisas boas; e sobre eles virá uma boa bênção.

versos.hebraico: שְׂפָתַ֥יִם יִשָּׁ֑ק מֵ֝שִׁ֗יב דְּבָרִ֥ים נְכֹחִֽים׃

controles.web: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
controles.kjv: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.
controles.livre: Quem responde palavras corretas é como se estivesse beijando com os lábios.

versos.hebraico: הָ֘כֵ֤ן בַּח֨וּץ׀ מְלַאכְתֶּ֗ךָ וְעַתְּדָ֣הּ בַּשָּׂדֶ֣ה לָ֑ךְ אַ֝חַ֗ר וּבָנִ֥יתָ בֵיתֶֽךָ׃פ

controles.web: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.
controles.kjv: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
controles.livre: Prepara tua obra de fora, e a deixa pronta no campo; somente depois edifica tua casa.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תְּהִ֣י עֵד־חִנָּ֣ם בְּרֵעֶ֑ךָ וַ֝הֲפִתִּ֗יתָ בִּשְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.
controles.kjv: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.
controles.livre: Não sejas testemunha contra teu próximo sem causa; por que enganarias com teus lábios?

versos.hebraico: אַל־תֹּאמַ֗ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽשָׂה־לִ֭י כֵּ֤ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־לּ֑וֹ אָשִׁ֖יב לָאִ֣ישׁ כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will render to the man according to his work.”
controles.kjv: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
controles.livre: Não digas: Assim como ele fez a mim, assim também farei a ele; pagarei a cada um conforme sua obra.

versos.hebraico: עַל־שְׂדֵ֣ה אִישׁ־עָצֵ֣ל עָבַ֑רְתִּי וְעַל־כֶּ֝֗רֶם אָדָ֥ם חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃

controles.web: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
controles.kjv: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
controles.livre: Passei junto ao campo do preguiçoso, e junto à vinha do homem sem juízo;

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּ֨ה עָ֘לָ֤ה כֻלּ֨וֹ׀ קִמְּשֹׂנִ֗ים כָּסּ֣וּ פָנָ֣יו חֲרֻלִּ֑ים וְגֶ֖דֶר אֲבָנָ֣יו נֶהֱרָֽסָה׃

controles.web: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.
controles.kjv: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
controles.livre: E eis que ela estava toda cheia de espinheiros, e sua superfície coberta de urtigas; e sua cerca de pedra estava derrubada.

versos.hebraico: וָֽאֶחֱזֶ֣ה אָ֭נֹכִֽי אָשִׁ֣ית לִבִּ֑י רָ֝אִ֗יתִי לָקַ֥חְתִּי מוּסָֽר׃

controles.web: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:
controles.kjv: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
controles.livre: Quando eu a vi, aprendi em meu coração, e ao olhá -la ,recebi instrução:

versos.hebraico: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט׀ חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִשְׁכָּֽב׃

controles.web: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep;
controles.kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
controles.livre: Um pouco de sono, cochilando um pouco, cruzando as mãos por um pouco de tempo deitado,

versos.hebraico: וּבָֽא־מִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ רֵישֶׁ֑ךָ וּ֝מַחְסֹרֶ֗יךָ כְּאִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן׃פ

controles.web: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your want as an armed man.
controles.kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
controles.livre: E assim tua pobreza virá como um assaltante; tua necessidade chegará como um homem armado.
